# Malady Wise

> Free daily medical puzzles and games (Medical and non-medical 'Normie' modes), plus plain-English health fact sheets, blood test explainers, exercise handouts, calculators and evidence-based deep dives for clinicians. Made with AI tools and overseen by an Australian GP. General education, not personal medical advice.

- Audience: the public, students and health professionals worldwide; Australian details where relevant.
- Spelling: Australian/British English. Units: SI.
- How pages are made: https://maladywise.com/about/#how-we-make-pages
- Privacy: https://maladywise.com/privacy/
- Sponsorship and advertising policy: https://maladywise.com/sponsorship/

## Daily medical puzzles and games

- [Anatomegaly: Daily Anatomy Quiz](https://maladywise.com/anatomegaly/): Anatomegaly is a free daily anatomy quiz: name the highlighted structure, the bone or the nerve in five quick rounds. For students, nurses and doctors.
- [Arcade Games: Basil + Clover, Stackulus and Mergeon](https://maladywise.com/arcade/): Free medical arcade games: Basil + Clover (cats, chaos and a vet), Stackulus (falling organs, daily challenge) and Mergeon (merge microbes up to a brain).
- [Arrhythmix: ECG Quiz (Free, Twice Weekly)](https://maladywise.com/arrhythmix/): Arrhythmix is a free ECG quiz every Monday and Thursday: a short case and an ECG on standard paper. Pick the rhythm in three tries and see the key features.
- [Basil + Clover: Free Cat Arcade Game](https://maladywise.com/basil-clover/): Basil + Clover is a free cat arcade game: help Basil kick everything off the kitchen bench, then survive a trip to the vet with his sister Clover.
- [Comorbix: Daily Medical Connections Game](https://maladywise.com/comorbix/): Comorbix is a free daily medical connections game: sixteen medical terms, four hidden groups of four. Find the links before you run out of mistakes.
- [Daily Trivia, Word Games and Mini Crossword](https://maladywise.com/normie/): Normie mode: free daily trivia, word games, a mini crossword, a cryptic crossword, word chains, a mystery stats card, a weekly mystery chart and a rarest-answer quiz with zero medicine. Same games, everyday knowledge. No sign-up.
- [Glimpsis: Spot the Diagnosis Photo Quiz](https://maladywise.com/glimpsis/): Glimpsis is a free daily spot the diagnosis photo quiz: one real clinical image, a one-line scenario, six options and three tries.
- [Gridectomy: Medical Mini Crossword](https://maladywise.com/gridectomy/): Gridectomy is a free daily medical mini crossword: a five-by-five grid with medical clues. Most people finish in a few minutes. New grid every day.
- [Linkase: Daily Medical Word Chain Game](https://maladywise.com/linkase/): Linkase is a free daily medical word chain game: each word links to the next to make a phrase, like blood, pressure, sore, throat. Fill the chain.
- [Medical Games and Quizzes: Free Daily Puzzles](https://maladywise.com/medical-games/): Free medical games and quizzes, new every day: a medical Wordle, anatomy quiz, ECG quiz, medical crossword, medical trivia and diagnosis games for students, nurses and doctors.
- [Mergeon: Free Organ Merge Game](https://maladywise.com/mergeon/): Mergeon is a free organ merge game: drop organs, match two of a kind and merge your way from microbe to brain. Same drops for everyone, every day.
- [Morphemia: Medical Spelling Bee](https://maladywise.com/morphemia/): Morphemia is a free daily medical spelling bee: make words from seven letters, always using the centre letter. Medical words score double.
- [Opacitis: X-ray Quiz (Daily Radiology Puzzle)](https://maladywise.com/opacitis/): Opacitis is a free daily X-ray quiz: one real X-ray, CT or ultrasound image and a short scenario. Name the diagnosis from six options in three tries.
- [Panelysis: Blood Test Quiz](https://maladywise.com/panelysis/): Panelysis is a free daily blood test quiz: read a fictional patient's blood results and pick the diagnosis in three tries. Learn to read blood tests.
- [Sensitosis: Sensitivity and Specificity Game](https://maladywise.com/sensitosis/): Sensitosis is a free daily game about sensitivity and specificity: guess how good real medical tests are, then see 100 people and the source.
- [Stackulus: Free Falling-Block Organ Game](https://maladywise.com/stackulus/): Stackulus is a free falling-block arcade game with organs: stack them, clear rows and learn an organ fact every level. Daily challenge and world board.
- [Sudokrine: Medical Sudoku](https://maladywise.com/sudokrine/): Sudokrine is a free daily medical sudoku with a hidden word: fill the grid with letters, then spell the hormone or gland. 6x6 early week, 9x9 at weekends.
- [Suturix: Medical Word Search](https://maladywise.com/suturix/): Suturix is a free daily medical word search: find the hidden theme words, plus a spangram that names the theme. Every letter is used once.
- [Wordemic: Daily Medical Wordle](https://maladywise.com/wordemic/): Wordemic is a free daily medical Wordle: guess the five-letter medical word in six tries (eight letters on Long Fridays). Australian spelling, no sign-up.
- [Zebritis: Rare Disease Quiz Game](https://maladywise.com/zebritis/): Zebritis is a free daily rare disease quiz game: name any correct answer to a medical prompt. Common answers score 1, rare zebras 10, the unicorn 20.

## Quizzes

- [Anatomy Quiz: Free Human Anatomy Quizzes](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/): Free anatomy quizzes with diagrams: brain, skull, muscles, bones, heart, head and neck, upper and lower limb. Instant answers and explanations.
- [Bones Quiz: Human Skeleton Anatomy Questions](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/bones/): Free bones quiz: 14 questions on the human skeleton, from the sternum, pelvis and spine to the smallest and longest bones, with explanations.
- [Brain Anatomy Quiz: Lobes, Cranial Nerves and More](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/brain/): Free brain anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the lobes, cerebellum, brainstem, language areas, cranial nerves and meninges, with short explanations.
- [ECG Quiz: Practice ECG Interpretation](https://maladywise.com/ecg-quiz/): Free ECG quiz: 15 questions with real-style rhythm strips and a 12-lead, from SVT and VT to heart block and STEMI. Practise ECG interpretation.
- [Head and Neck Anatomy Quiz: Eye, Ear and Neck](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/head-and-neck/): Free head and neck anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the eye, the ear, the larynx and the nerves of the neck, with diagrams and short explanations.
- [Heart Anatomy Quiz: Chambers, Valves and Vessels](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/heart/): Free heart anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the four chambers, the valves, the great vessels and the coronary arteries, with diagrams and explanations.
- [Lower Limb Anatomy Quiz: Hip, Knee, Leg and Foot](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/lower-limb/): Free lower limb anatomy quiz: 14 questions on the femur, tibia and fibula, knee ligaments and menisci, foot bones and leg nerves, with explanations.
- [Medical Terminology Quiz: Prefixes and Suffixes](https://maladywise.com/medical-terminology-quiz/): Free medical terminology quiz: three 10-question rounds on prefixes, suffixes and word roots, plus a quick list of common medical prefixes and suffixes.
- [Muscle Quiz: Anatomy of the Major Muscles](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/muscles/): Free muscle anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the biggest, longest and smallest muscles, the rotator cuff, quadriceps, hamstrings and their nerves.
- [Skull Anatomy Quiz: Cranial Bones, Sutures and More](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/skull/): Free skull anatomy quiz: 14 questions on the cranial and facial bones, sutures, fontanelles and foramina, each with a short explanation.
- [Upper Limb Anatomy Quiz: Arm, Wrist and Hand](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/upper-limb/): Free upper limb anatomy quiz: 14 questions on the arm, forearm and wrist bones, the carpal bones and the nerves of the hand, with explanations.
- [Which Medical Specialty Suits You? (Quiz)](https://maladywise.com/medical-specialty-quiz/): Which medical specialty suits you? 14 fun scenario questions match you to GP, emergency, surgery, radiology, psychiatry and more, with real training facts.
- [X-Ray Quiz: Chest, Abdominal and Bone X-Rays](https://maladywise.com/x-ray-quiz/): Free X-ray quiz: 18 real chest, abdominal, bone and paediatric X-rays, easy to hard, with key findings and a tip for each. Practise X-ray interpretation.

- [GLP-1 Side Effects: How Common Each One Is](https://maladywise.com/glp-1/side-effects/): GLP-1 side effects with real trial numbers: how often nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, constipation and hair loss happen on semaglutide and tirzepatide.
- [Ozempic, Wegovy and Mounjaro on the PBS: Cost in Australia](https://maladywise.com/glp-1/pbs-cost-australia/): Which GLP-1 medicines are on the PBS in November 2026: Ozempic for type 2 diabetes, Wegovy’s pending listing, Mounjaro, private costs, plus US and UK.
